title: Five-second character intro
summary: Introduce a character in exactly five seconds: five one-second keyframes that keep the character consistent, one animated plate, optional narration and captions.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Character images
inputs.description: One or more images of the character; the clearest becomes the identity reference.

inputs.label: Motion reference
inputs.description: An optional short clip whose camera and rhythm the intro should follow.

inputs.label: Spoken line
inputs.description: A short line to narrate, or permission to draft one.

stages.title: Choose the identity image
stages.description: Pick the canonical image and write the character rules.

stages.title: Five keyframes
stages.description: One still per second, each with a visible change of action.

stages.title: Animate
stages.description: One five-second plate from the approved keyframes.

stages.title: Voice and export
stages.description: Optional narration and captions, exact five-second export, review.
